title: Patient-level microsimulation
primary_chapter_title: Decision Modelling, Simulation, and the Value of Information
purpose: Simulates heterogeneous patients over repeated cycles so history, subgroup risk, adherence, and individual outcomes can affect AI value.
input: `Cohort` sheet with patient_id, age, risk_score, subgroup, adherence probability; `Parameters` sheet with cycles, baseline event probability, AI relative risk, event cost, annual cost, utility loss, and threshold.
outputs: Patient-level outcomes, subgroup summaries, event counts, mean costs/QALYs, incremental NMB, uncertainty distribution, and subgroup charts.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
